subtasks.description: Declare all internal wires, registers, and constants: state register, next_state wire, Watchdog_Cnt, debounce counter, card_present, synchroniser stages (req_q, ack_q, req_in_int, ack_in_int), complete, CRC_check_enable, index_check_enable, response_size, cmd_out, settings, RESP_1_REG, STATUS_REG, NORMAL_INT_REG, ERR_INT_REG, and other combinational intermediates. Ensure port declarations faithfully follow the interface specification.
Pure combinational always block computing next_state from current state, New_CMD, ack_in_int, and complete using the state transition table (default to IDLE).
Sequential always block with asynchronous reset; on reset set state to IDLE (3'b001), on clock edge update state with next_state.

Combinational block computing response_size from CMD_SET_REG[1:0], assembling 40-bit next_cmd_out = {2'b01, CMD_SET_REG[13:8], ARG_REG} and 16-bit next_settings = {WORD_SELECT, data_read, data_write, 3'b111, CRCE, response_size}.
Sequential debounce logic: on reset clear 4‑bit counter and card_present; if !card_detect increment counter (saturating at 15), else clear counter; set card_present when counter == 15.
Two-stage synchronizers for req_in and ack_in: on reset clear all stages; each clock edge shift req_in → req_q → req_in_int and ack_in → ack_q → ack_in_int.

Sequential block: on reset clear all outputs and internal state; on clock edge assign NORMAL_INT_REG[1]=card_present, NORMAL_INT_REG[2]=~card_present; then per-state operations: IDLE monitors serial_status, SETUP latches cmd_out and settings from combinational next values and resets interrupts and watchdog, EXECUTE increments watchdog, handles handshake, timeout, CRC/index checks, response capture, and interrupt updates as specified. Use explicit per-signal assignments; avoid generate or loops.
constraints: Use flattened scalar assignments for all registers and outputs; do not use unpacked arrays, generate, genvar, or multidimensional references.
